::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Samsung's semiconductor R&D in Bengaluru works on Exynos mobile SoCs and modem design. Part of Samsung's broader India R&D footprint which is its largest outside South Korea. In October 2025 SSIR launched a hiring push for AI chip design across System LSI, Memory and Foundry, aiming to become a core Samsung AI-chip design centre.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Exynos mobile application processors, 5G modem IPs, display driver ICs, and custom neural processing units for on-device AI.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 5/5:** Leading-edge mobile SoCs, modems and AI NPUs.
- **Strategic depth 4/5:** Works on Exynos SoCs, modems and NPUs; core R&D status but product ownership remains in Korea.
- **Design completeness 5/5:** Teams contribute across SoC, modem and NPU design; full-chip scope per existing entry.
- **India scale 4/5:** Semiconductor research workforce grew from ~1,000 (2019) to ~5,000 (2025).
